reviews.text: The time it takes to make an appointment, only to have the line hang up without anyone answering.

Terrible experience I advise against bringing your animals to this clinic. We arrived with the dog who was sick. The first thing they gave us was the cost estimate without yet knowing the dog's condition if he would be saved. The doctor was very rude. Avoid if you don't want your animals to die (RESPONSE TO THE CLINIC). I certainly won't put my real registration on the internet, but you are a bunch of incompetent people. You said my dog ​​arrived cyanotic. You tore him from my arms and sedated and intubated him without even informing you that the dog had a heart condition. When consulting my trusted veterinarian, he said that a dog with a heart condition cannot be sedated because it risks cardiac arrest. We went in to see the dog's condition and found that instead of putting him on oxygen, they were pumping him with a pump. In practice, you caused the dog's death with your incompetence. Change your job!!!!!!!
Today at this clinic I found a vet who loves animals and, above all, knows how to solve problems in a matter of minutes. Thank you, Dr. Glauco, also on behalf of Victor and Tokio.

Around August 10th we brought our little dog who was taken away from us because he was considered serious and they practically kicked us out of the room. After about 40 minutes they presented us with the bill of 800 euros for all the treatments that the dog should have had. At 6 in the morning we were told that he had passed away so they gave us a discount and we only had to pay 580 euros!!!!! P.S. To cremate the dog just take him 4km away to the Muratella and you will pay only 25 euros. Obviously they don't tell you this option but only tell you to call Taffo or they will take care of it at a price 4 times that! Zero empathy in this clinic. I do not recommend it at all.

Terrible experience. I arrived with my dog ​​who was sick. They took him and made me leave without saying anything. I was not able to be close to him even in his last moments. There was no empathy. The first thing they did was present me with the bill without yet knowing the real situation of the dog. The doctor was not very empathetic and very arrogant. They made me pay a whopping 580 euros and only because the dog had died. Otherwise it would have been much more. If I had another dog in the future, I would definitely not bring him to this clinic. NOT RECOMMENDED!!!!!!

I took my cat four months ago for a blood sugar test (which they didn't do because they weren't able to). The cat came out scared, with over 400 mg of diabetes, pee stains, and all his paws shaved and bruised because they couldn't even take a blood sample. A day at the clinic, including an ultrasound, after which they wanted to operate on him for no reason. Total cost: €515, with terrible treatment towards the cat and presumption towards us. I recommend you take your pets elsewhere.

I must say that I recommend this place with great confidence, although I was very sad for my little dog who was not well, the surgeon Dr. Alessandro Conteduca reassured me and calmed me immediately, the approach he had with the little dog struck me very much, before starting the visit he filled her with cuddles and caresses, something that has never happened to me wherever I have been with Rocco for visits, very professional, patient with my questions and very explicit about everything, the polite staff with an exceptional welcome, thank you very much from the bottom of my heart 🙏

On August 13th, I arrived at this clinic, recommended by a friend, and I must say they did not disappoint my expectations. I was truly desperate for my cat, but right from the start I found competent, humane doctors who welcomed us and treated us with all the necessary care and, above all, were immediately ready to intervene (he had emergency intestinal surgery). It's the first time I've found a peaceful environment, where the respect and love they put into this profession is palpable as soon as you enter! I sincerely thank Doctor William, Glauco, and Alessandro for giving my big cat another chance, and of course, a big thank you to all of you for your kindness and expertise. Of course, I highly recommend them to anyone in need!!!

Thanks to Glauco and his team for saving Apollo❤️
We've been clients of this clinic for at least 10 years, bringing both our dogs and cats. Two weeks ago, I rushed my cat Apollo to the clinic one night with a severe urinary tract obstruction. They performed emergency surgery and kept him in the clinic for two days. After that, Glauco and I began a recovery program at home with various checkups and daily updates. Now everything is finally fine and Apollo is back to his life. Thank you, you're fantastic.
Thank you. You saved Shaka's life, who was dying in my car with a pneumothorax. I'll pick him up tomorrow. Let's hope for the best.

This clinic is different from all the others and stands out first and foremost for the human component, which is put first here.
Competence and fair prices complete the picture.
Other clinics should follow this example.
Thanks to all the staff.

Terrible experience and a complete lack of professionalism and empathy.

We went to this clinic on Sunday evening, June 7th, around 11:30 PM, for an emergency: our 30-kg dog had been shaking and tilting her head for an hour. We suspected a foxtail, a completely new phenomenon for us.

We were greeted by a doctor with pink hair. From the very beginning, even though the dog was scared but otherwise very good, the doctor was clearly annoyed. She checked her ears: nothing on the left, but we noticed a clear discomfort on the right. Supported by a young nurse and myself, the inspection lasted very little, and the doctor dismissed the matter, saying that there was nothing wrong and that she would continue to have her checked later.

When it was time to leave, we asked for the cost of the checkup (which lasted a total of 10 minutes) out of politeness. Initially, we were told we didn't owe anything, but after insisting we weren't at fault, we were asked for €56 for a "checkup" (which we didn't even see). The surreal thing happened after we paid: the doctor left the office, saying she wanted to check the dog again to "be sure." A move that seemed decidedly smart and belated.
Back inside, the dog was obviously more agitated than before. I found myself alone on the floor, holding 30 kg of dog, while the doctor continued to complain in an annoyed manner because the animal wouldn't stay still. Faced with such impatience, I pointed out, "Excuse me, but if you said there was nothing before, what exactly do you want to find now?" In response, she got annoyed and rudely shut the instruments in the box. Only after speaking with her colleague and demanding one last try (since the dog was still feeling sick and we'd just paid almost €60), the doctor came out and asked if the dog was fasting so she could administer anesthesia.
Which, incidentally, would have cost another €250.
So the dog was fine a moment ago, and then you're suggesting anesthesia?
Rudeness and very little empathy towards animals and their owners. If you don't have the patience and passion needed for this job, perhaps it would be best to change careers.
This clinic is highly inadvisable unless you have a trusted veterinarian on-site.
I highly recommend them. I have a small dog, so I trusted them, and I was right. They helped us get through a tough time. Very professional and caring. 🔝🔝🔝🔝 …

I thank all the staff for their extreme kindness and patience with my very old and ailing Mia. A special thanks to Dr. Alessandra, whose professionalism and care immediately made her feel better, and to the staff who helped me manage the arduous transition from the car to the clinic without her having to.

Yesterday, accompanied by some family members, I took my little dog to this shelter for his final journey. I immediately found the staff friendly. The doctor I met was very professional. My Zar has become a little angel, and I'll never forget him, but my heart is big enough to love other dogs, and in the not-too-distant future, I'll get another one.

I WANTED TO THANK ALL THE STAFF WITH ALL MY HEART, A MONTH AGO I HAD TO MAKE A SAD DECISION, TO ACCOMPANI MY BELOVED ZOE, A BLACK LABRADOR, FOR ME AND MY HUSBAND, SHE WAS AN ANGEL ON EARTH, (I ALWAYS TOLD HER SO💖), TO FALL ASLEEP FOREVER, SHE WAS SICK, THANK YOU TO EVERYONE FROM THE HEART💖 …

We had an excellent experience with Dr. Daduzzio and her entire team. The care we received was truly outstanding from start to finish. The front desk staff were welcoming, kind, and incredibly courteous, which made us feel at ease right away.

Dr. Daduzzio provided attentive and compassionate care, and we felt confident that we were in very good hands. As non-fluent Italian speakers, we especially appreciated how well she communicated in English—far better than she gave herself credit for—which made a big difference for us.

Everyone we encountered was friendly, professional, and genuinely caring. We are very grateful for the level of service we received and would highly recommend this practice to anyone in need of veterinary care.
Lola was in great hands

After many negative experiences with money-grubbers and profiteers, we found kind and honest people. On Easter Thursday, our little Morosita wasn't breathing well. We took her to a clinic that, without even examining her, sent us to Alpha Vet because they thought she needed a surgeon. I'm grateful for their incompetence, because instead I found professional staff who immediately took charge of the situation and within five minutes diagnosed the cat with pleural effusion. After three days, we learned that the cat had FIP. Morosita may not survive, and it's no one's fault; unfortunately, it's a serious condition, but I have to thank the staff for their professionalism, humanity, and honesty. At least from today, I know where to take my eight pets in case I need an emergency visit. Thank you for everything, you were fantastic.
A welcoming place with helpful, kind, and empathetic staff. Special thanks to Dr. Morelli for the thoroughness and transparency with our cat Lala's diagnosis.

We brought our dachshund in at night for what appeared to be food poisoning. The doctor and nurse who welcomed us were immediately very kind and extremely empathetic.

The next day, Rambo underwent emergency surgery, and once again, everyone—doctors, nurses, and the receptionist—proved professional, helpful, and truly human.

We had a wonderful experience in every way. It's the only vet where Rambo enters happy, running, and without fear. ❤️

I wanted to thank the entire staff from the bottom of my heart. Today I had to make a sad decision: to take my beloved furry friend Italo to sleep forever. He was sick, but he lived a full life and gave me 15 years of happiness. All this thanks to the care you all showed him. Thank you again. Brian and Italo

Good morning, I had an emergency need for a cat that wasn't mine at the veterinary clinic. The staff were friendly on the phone and very professional and empathetic. I give the clinic a very positive review.

Today my 11-year-old dog injured her paw, practically breaking a nail. Since I was far from home and it was Sunday, I found this clinic and I have to say I was very happy with it. They were very kind and didn't even charge me.

Thank you so much
I brought my cat in urgently because she was having trouble breathing, and I found the service to be professional and welcoming. The only downside is that they're a little pricey.
A thousand thanks!

Dear Dr. Glauco Ciccone,
I would like to sincerely thank you for the great professionalism and expertise you demonstrated in caring for our cat Silver, who underwent an endoscopy. Your intervention was crucial, and I am deeply grateful for the attention, dedication, and compassion with which you handled the case and always answered the phone despite you being on vacation.
G. Rita
Fantastic experience, I took my 8 puppies for a visit and vaccinations and I was welcomed very affectionately by the very talented Dr. William Morelli, thank you very much.

Doctor Conteduca Alessandro is a wonderful surgeon with a humanity towards animals that is unique, polite, professional today he saved my ARISTOTLE brought in in critical conditions it was the time he also had to finish from his shift but he stayed to operate and to this guy I have to thank from the bottom of my heart also all the staff are wonderful the secretary of an infinite sweetness thank you from the bottom of my heart ❤️ ❤️ ❤️ thank you I advise you all to bring your animals thank you
Thank you so much for your help - I will definitely be back if my dog ​​has any other problems.

Thank you so much for making this year's first day a great one! Yesterday, New Year's Eve, our dachshund ingested hashish in a park, which someone had definitely dropped... We rushed to the emergency room, without being sure what was in that plastic bag found nearby... But he was already starting to show the first effects: he was staggering, weak, and trembling severely. They welcomed us right away to the clinic and promptly gave him a lavage, fluid therapy, and charcoal, keeping him hospitalized overnight... This morning at 11:00, he was returned to us splendidly and in excellent shape! It's all a distant memory, and it only happened yesterday at 3:00 PM. Warmth and smiles in this clinic where we went for the first time... So much empathy and humanity, even letting us go back to take him to the toilet. Thank you for this gift to start the year.

In a time of great fear for our Luna, this clinic was a fundamental point of reference. We brought her in under conditions that had terrified us, and thanks to their care, she is now well, running, eating, and wagging her tail as always. They cared for her with respect, kindness, and professionalism.
We owe them a huge part of our serenity. Thank you so much, from our entire family and our Luna. ❤️🐾

On behalf of myself and my entire family, I wanted to thank
Dr. Ciccone (known to his friends as GLAUCO) and ALL his staff for their professionalism, but above all, their humanity, with which they accompanied the life of our "terrible" Tigger until the very last moment.
Thank you for everything... but I'm sure we'll see each other again soon.
🐈‍⬛🌈❤️👋🏼
Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us positive feedback.
I took my puppy Leo to Alphavet and had a great experience. The staff was incredibly friendly and the prices were very competitive. Fantastic!

I wanted to thank Dr. Morelli for everything he did for my dog, Ciuffo. Especially for his humanity and kindness. I highly recommend the entire facility for the expertise and compassion the staff showed us. Thank you.
Thank you so much, your feedback is very valuable to us!
We went last night for a problem with our one-and-a-half-month-old kitten. I'm giving it 5 stars for the tact, helpfulness, and expertise of the two doctors who saw us.
Thank you very much for your feedback.

I'm sorry to have to post a negative review. I live in the neighborhood and know that many people are satisfied with this clinic. It probably depends on the professionals you encounter. I had a bad experience, faced with a poorly conducted examination (especially regarding the semiotic maneuvers), a lack of empathy with both the dog and its owners, vague treatment and care recommendations, and an incomplete report that made even subsequent specialists look askance. I'm sorry, but for me, IT'S A NO.

On behalf of my entire family, I would like to thank Dr. Ciccone and the entire staff at Alpha Vet Clinic for their tremendous dedication, professionalism, and compassion over the years, especially during the final moments of our beloved Aria's life.
We always felt at home.

I'd like to share my many years of experience with AlphaVet Clinic, where I've received top-quality veterinary care for years. My dogs have suffered from various ailments, but thanks to the entire team, I've always been able to successfully resolve them. As so many other clients have said, you'll find incredibly helpful and caring people here.
I couldn't recommend anything more reliable!

I've been coming to Alphavet Clinica Veterinaria Portuense for many years, first with my long-lived dog, and now with my newly neutered pups. Over the years, I've always found this facility staffed by truly special people: from the receptionists to the nursing staff to the veterinarians.
In the most difficult moments, I've found kindness, compassion, and a willingness to listen. But not only that: the high level of professionalism is evident in everything—in tests, diagnoses, complex procedures, routine and emergency care. Whatever the time, whenever you need it, there's always someone there to welcome you with sensitivity and professionalism, who makes an effort to understand what's wrong and intervene promptly, explaining what's happening and reassuring both us and our four-legged friends.
And even in the waiting room, talking to other clients, you can feel the same trust. Highly recommended!!
Thank you so much to the entire Alphavet team!
They're quite good. The night doctors are excellent, very sweet, and very skilled. During the day, there are other doctors, who, in my opinion, are less empathetic. But it's a good clinic.

Terrible experience, my cat was hospitalized from August 14th to August 18th. On the day of admission, August 14th, Dr. Ciccone diagnosed him with a metastatic tumor. On days 14 and 15, the cat vomited the food he was given. A doctor on duty at that point advised me to euthanize him, because whatever he ate was causing him to vomit. Despite this, they suggested a CT scan, which I didn't have done. On day 18, I took the cat away, paying just under 900 euros. Today, September 17th, the cat, with his problems, is alive and eating. Around August 20th, I found a first-rate doctor at the veterinary clinic on Via Amedeo Crivellucci, who is still treating him with love.

I went to them for an emergency regarding my cat, who suddenly had breathing problems. They responded promptly, and now my little girl is slowly recovering. Thank you so much. Thanks to William, Noemi, and all the other doctors who cared for Alice. Everyone was extremely knowledgeable and professional. Thanks also to Valeria for her humanity and helpfulness.

At the clinic, I found not only well-trained and attentive professionals who knew how to listen to the animal's caregiver in need, but also kind and caring people. And this aspect, which makes all the difference, should never be taken for granted.

I brought my 17-year-old dog to the emergency room one Saturday evening in August. After a careful history and diagnostic tests, the doctor was able to identify the problem, and we had to admit her urgently. During her hospital stay, she underwent further tests and then underwent surgery.
We wanted to thank the entire team for saving her! Despite the exhaustion and grueling shifts, I was always welcomed with kindness and empathy. ❤️🦊 Thank you so much.

I used the clinic for an emergency, and I must say the outcome was negative.
I recommend going to the facility only if you know who to leave your dog or cat with, as the doctors there aren't all capable and are simply trying to run tests without properly assessing the animal's health, thus fleecing the poor unfortunate.
I don't feel like generalizing, as I spoke to many clients while waiting, and they all reiterated that they use the clinic and always go to the same vets, who are well-trained and competent.
I didn't have any names, so I took it as a matter of chance, only to end up with a hefty bill and a ruined cat... that's all.
They are amazing!!
When treating leishmaniasis, stay away from Dr. D'Andrea!

I went to this clinic on the recommendation of someone... I have sterilized 3 female dogs, I keep them in foster care, they are strays, I asked for a quote so I knew the cost, I asked if it was possible to have a discount and this seems legitimate to me it would have been legitimate to reply that it was not possible... and not increase the price compared to the one previously reported and pretend to apply the discount, since it is considered not only a mockery but also a "fraud" crime. I took care to report the matter to the doctor Glauco who certainly apologized for the secretary by offering me the vaccination for the female dogs... which obviously I have done elsewhere, I do not accept charity, but I advise the receptionist to act more politely and more honestly, at least in respect of the image of the clinic.

I arrived by chance on a scorching Sunday afternoon in late June because my cat Amelia was having breathing difficulties. They took care of her immediately, with professionalism and care. I thank Dr. Morelli for his approach as well as his expertise. He perfectly understood my anxiety and concerns. It was an absolutely positive experience for us. We will definitely be using the facility again, and Dr. Morelli in particular.
My Maltese is cared for here. I had a great experience, especially with Dr. Marrone.

I went to the clinic for an emergency, as it's the closest to my house. My dog ​​had lost his stitches after surgery, and this is the result of how they "partially" stitched him up, telling me it couldn't be better and that the unstitched area could stay that way... which wasn't a problem because it would heal on its own (other than the infection, I don't imagine what mark would be left). For the "work done," I paid €160! Worried about how my dog ​​was doing, I went elsewhere, where they perfectly saturated and bandaged him! Everything was documented with photos at their clinic... before and after! We will definitely never see each other again.
HIGHLY NOT RECOMMENDED!!!!

We brought our Joy after visiting another center; she had a high fever and a suspected intestinal slowdown. The doctor who examined her reassured us and even performed an ultrasound, just to be sure, which we didn't have to pay for. We had a great experience.
Friendly and kind, they immediately gave me an appointment for my dog, a thorough visit with an honest price
Excellent. Nothing to add, my dog ​​and I are grateful. Alessandro takes care of me, he's wonderful. Total trust. My dog ​​is always in excellent hands, no matter what happens.

My dog ​​was dying, and even though it was late at night, I found the staff prompt and competent. They practically snatched her from me. Blood tests were done in less than a quarter of an hour, and within ten minutes, she was in the operating room. They managed to save her. The staff were competent, serious, professional, and very human. During her stay, I found only the most helpful people, even though I tried to get in even at the most unusual hours. They were simply kind and courteous. I thank Glauco and all his assistants for their work.

We didn't get there by chance; we were looking for a miracle. But my Floretta and I, even though we were complete strangers, were pampered and comforted in the most difficult decision an owner can make in their dog's life.
And so it happened that, amidst so many tears, caresses, and hugs, her little heart stopped beating.
I'm still crying, but I'm deeply grateful for the psychological support, the compassion, and the kindness of Dr. Glauco and the entire Alphavet staff.

Our Pets' Angels

Number One ♥️

Very professional, kind, thoughtful, and...honest!! Thank you!!!
From Simba
One star, because there were no zero stars.

Arrived late in the evening with my Jimmy who wasn't walking. They were able to reassure me right away and perform all the checks. Now Jimmy is fine and running again ☺️🙏 Very kind and professional staff. Thank you from Jimmy and Marco. …
Fantastic facility, excellent quality and prices. The doctors and staff are empathetic and efficient. The clinic is open 24 hours a day. I recommend it to everyone! My cats thank you.

I warmly thank all the staff. For the welcome, professionalism, and care (sweetness) they had for my little Lilly. I immediately felt that my little girl was in excellent hands. I will also take my Maltese Minù to be spayed by them as soon as possible. They will always be my point of reference. A special thanks goes to Dr. Glauco who operated on her and to Valeria who reassured me when I was full of anxiety. You are unique with humans 🥰🥰 and with dogs 🐶🐶. Thank you for everything.
This place should be called pet's death, not pet's life.

My beagle was so ill over the weekend and I had no idea what to do. I called the clinic and the vet on the phone told me to bring him in as soon as possible. As soon as I arrived, I burst into tears and couldn't even speak. The staff and vet were so kind and so empathetic. The vet I had spoken to on the phone saw my dog, Alan, straight away and was just so gentle and thorough with him. Alan already started to feel better after the injections he got in the clinic. The vet then took the time to explain the results of the blood tests, as well as the treatment to me and I felt much better leaving than I did going in. Our pets are so important to us and they definitely understand that! There were a lot of sick pets in the clinic that day, but they couldn't have been in better hands. I'm so glad my friend advised me to go there and so grateful for the help the vet gave Alan. Thanks a million!

I don't know where to start. Unprofessional, rude, and superficial. The first one is a short, bald guy who showed up without a lab coat and arrogantly pretended he already had everything figured out. In fact, it wasn't at all what he thought. Luckily, once we figured out the right place, we immediately changed vets. Maybe you guys should change careers.

I brought my dog ​​Gioia to this clinic. She was in a state of distress; she was no longer herself. The doctors immediately understood what was wrong after immediately performing biochemical tests and an ultrasound. She was operated on the next day by Dr. Glauco. The operation was a complete success. She was then admitted to the hospital for post-operative recovery and surrounded by the loving care of the doctors and nurses, whom I publicly thank along with the entire staff. Gioia is now doing very well. I highly recommend this clinic!

Poor management of the disease by the dog's doctor, underestimation of the obvious symptoms. I tried to explain the seriousness of the situation, but she reassured me, telling me to stay calm. The final outcome? Death of the dog.
I curse myself for not having consulted another veterinarian.

I will always be grateful to the entire staff, and to Dr. Glauco, who, for the second time in my Maltese's life, saved her with all his professionalism and humanity. In addition to the care we received and the patience, we always felt emotionally pampered. During the various operations my dog ​​underwent, Dr. Glauco was always very honest in his diagnoses, scrupulous and meticulous in his care. We want to heartily thank everyone, from the nurses to the veterinarians, to Azzurra, Erica, and Valeria. A clinic, a family. Thank you, thank you from the bottom of our hearts, not only for your professionalism but also for your honesty! You are the best. Thank you, Glauco. Luna thanks you so much that she will still be with her mom and dad.

It's been a tough and difficult time for us and our beloved Muso, and it will be until, hopefully, he's out of danger. We've relied on this wonderful team of veterinarians, whom I hope any pet owner would encounter in a time of difficulty. Muso's situation has been complicated and difficult, a diagnosis hard to accept and a decision to make that has put us to the test. But all of this has been made easier thanks to these people. First and foremost, by Erica's kindness and smile at the reception desk, then by the professionalism, humanity, and kindness of Dr. Matteo Fantauzzo and Dr. Andrea Asta, and all the other colleagues at the clinic who have had the opportunity to get to know Muso. Their goal is one: to save and care for our four-legged friend with the utmost tenderness, viewing him not as a source of income, but as a true patient. Every penny spent was spent with a smile and the immense gratitude we felt toward these professionals. Unfortunately, all veterinary healthcare is paid for, but when you meet people like this, you realize it's never enough compared to all the love and passion they put into their work. It's not over yet, but I know for sure that Muso will be in good hands and surrounded by a love you rarely find in these places.

To say thank you is an understatement.

Love, Ludovica, Manuel, and Muso

BAD EXPERIENCE. Despite several negative reviews, given its proximity to home, we took our dog for a simple blood test for a routine checkup.
After almost a week and several reminders, they sent us the test results with alarmingly INCORRECT values, diagnosing (over the phone) a nonexistent condition. In fact, we had this and other tests repeated at another clinic, where they returned completely different results and no evidence of any condition.

When I contacted the clinic to ask for an explanation of the inconsistency in their results, my wife's response was: "Don't worry, it's better this way, it means the dog is fine." Furthermore, when I asked for a possible reimbursement for the expenses incurred for the incorrect test, the vet denied any negligence, raising her voice in an unprofessional manner and blaming us for the incorrect result, claiming it couldn't be proven that the dog was fasting, despite us having respected the 9-hour fasting period they requested.
Unacceptable behavior. NOT RECOMMENDED.

Terrible, tactless doctor.
I'll never bring any animals here again.

Qualified and helpful staff, kind and loving with furry friends. Highly recommended, not 5 stars, but 10.
Patrizia (Jack Russell Cindy)
Everyone was excellent, helpful, and Dr. Schiano was fantastic. Thank you for everything, you're great.
Fantastic. My dog ​​was saved from acute pancreatitis. The vets and nurses were professional but also humane, helpful and always kind to the animals and us owners!

In my desperation, I found a welcoming and warm place, because on Saturday, not even the vet I turned to was on duty, for my Trace's final journey.
I begin by thanking Valeria and Chiara, and the doctor who made sure my little prince fell asleep, then gave me the time I wanted with him.
I thank Sara, the day I went to pick him up; her hug, in a small way, caressed this soul wounded by immense pain.
See you soon, the rest of the crew I have at home.
❤️

I wanted to sincerely thank Dr. Fantauzzo for his helpfulness, humanity, and kindness, which I experienced on an unfortunately sad occasion.
I am a volunteer and contacted the clinic on Sunday regarding an emergency regarding a dog that had been killed in Ponte Galeria. His name was Giorgio. We urgently needed a cold storage unit for his poor little body, which had been battered and thrown into the river, to preserve it for the autopsy.

Dr. Fantauzzo responded and, immediately understanding the gravity of the situation, made the cold storage available to me within 10 minutes without a fight. He contacted me and immediately confirmed that the clinic was available to take in poor Giorgio.

In the end, however, I learned from people on site that they responded to the rescue from Pomezia, as it was a Sunday, and the little body was taken elsewhere.

Thank you so much for your kindness. ♥️

At your clinic, you are truly not only competent veterinarians but also kindhearted people.

Thank you.
Thanks to Gabriella and Diletta who, with so much patience and attention, solved my dog's problem!!!
